downloaded_assets.title: Futuristic Digital Circuitry
downloaded_assets.description: Abstract high-tech visualization with red/orange glow
downloaded_assets.visual_description: A complex layered digital circuitry background with glowing red and orange geometric shapes, white light streaks, and deep shadows. It feels like looking into the core of a powerful server or AI engine.
downloaded_assets.color_notes: Dominant: Deep red (#91414E), bright orange accents, and dark tech shadows. Perfect for 'FireScrapling' dark mode with orange accents.
downloaded_assets.alt_text: Glowing red and orange abstract digital circuitry
downloaded_assets.why_it_was_chosen: Perfectly matches the app's 'Fire' theme and dark mode requirement with powerful red/orange tech visuals.

downloaded_assets.title: Abstract Data Matrix
downloaded_assets.description: Vibrant digital art showcasing red and black hues in a matrix pattern
downloaded_assets.visual_description: An abstract 3D grid of glowing red cubes and data points receding into a dark horizon. High contrast with intense red saturation.
downloaded_assets.color_notes: Dominant: Intense red (#8B2A35) and black. High energy and modern feel.
downloaded_assets.alt_text: Vibrant red and black digital data matrix
downloaded_assets.why_it_was_chosen: Strong alternative for a more 'raw data' or matrix-focused aesthetic.

downloaded_assets.title: Glowing Data Network
downloaded_assets.description: Abstract network structure with orange lines and dots
downloaded_assets.visual_description: A dense, intricate web of glowing orange lines and nodes against a pitch-black background. Represents connectivity and complex data extraction paths.
downloaded_assets.color_notes: Dominant: Vibrant orange (#621E04) on pure black.
downloaded_assets.alt_text: Glowing orange network web of lines and dots
downloaded_assets.why_it_was_chosen: Abstractly represents the 'web' in web scraping while maintaining the fire/orange theme.

downloaded_assets.alt_text: Code editor with orange and red syntax highlighting
